{{Top|leg}}
'''Security sensors''' were a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. They could detect weapons, except for when the weapon was specifically designed to break apart to avoid detection.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Security sensors were placed throughout the [[Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall]] to monitor unauthorized access. [[Selby Jarrad]] dismantled several to conceal her presence when she infiltrated the Governor's Hall.<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
